```yaml
name: E2E Portal Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  e2e-portal-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # --------------------
      # Rust setup & caching
      # --------------------
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-version: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Cache Cargo git index
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-index-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-index-

      - name: Cache Cargo build
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-build-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-build-

      # --------------------
      # Node.js & Playwright
      # --------------------
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install npm dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Cache Playwright binaries
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-playwright-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-playwright-

      # --------------------
      # Prepare environment
      # --------------------
      - name: Install netcat
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y netcat

      # --------------------
      # Run E2E tests
      # --------------------
      - name: Run E2E tests
        env:
          SOCKS5_UDP: 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          echo "Building imix_connect with SOCKS5 UDP support..."
          cargo build --release --features socks5_udp

          echo "Starting imix_connect..."
          ./target/release/imix_connect --udp-support &
          IMIX_PID=$!

          echo "Waiting for imix_connect to be ready on port 1080..."
          until nc -z localhost 1080; do sleep 1; done
          echo "imix_connect is ready."

          echo "Running Playwright UI tests..."
          npx playwright test

          echo "Running traffic verification script..."
          if [ -x "./scripts/verify_traffic.sh" ]; then
            ./scripts/verify_traffic.sh
          else
            echo "verify_traffic.sh not found or not executable; skipping."
          fi

          echo "Shutting down imix_connect..."
          kill $IMIX_PID
          wait $IMIX_PID 2>/dev/null || true
```
